win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - VELVET NIGHTS
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus keeps the mechanics of the GOLDEN HITS bonus. Each position will have a Golden Frame from the start with either a Multiplier or a Jackpot. Clover Crystals and FS symbols do not appear in this bonus.

multipliers.name: GOLDEN FRAMES
multipliers.behavior:
Golden Frames will land on positions during a spin and reveal a Multiplier or a Jackpot when the grid settles. A Golden Frame counts as part of a win if the symbol in its position is included in a winning payline. When a Multiplier Frame is part of a win, the win is multiplied by the value of the Multiplier. If there is more than one Multiplier in a win, the Multiplier values will be added together to form a total, which is applied to the win.

 Possible Multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Jackpot Frames award one of four different cash prizes when part of a win or when collected by a Clover Crystal. The Jackpot value is based on your current bet. When a Jackpot is part of a win, the win is multiplied by your bet to determine the total awarded amount. If more than 1 Jackpot is part of a win, all Jackpot values will be added together to determine the total awarded amount. After the wins are awarded, any Multiplier Frame or Jackpot Frame will be removed from the grid for the next spin.

 The four Jackpots are:

 MINI: 25x

 MAJOR: 100x

 MEGA: 500x

 {maxJackpotLabel}: {highestJackpotMultiplier}x

 The current value of each Jackpot is displayed outside the grid on the Jackpot Board.

multipliers.name: CLOVER CRYSTALS
multipliers.behavior: The Clover Crystal symbol collects the values of all Multipliers and Jackpots that land during a spin, even if they don't form a winning combination. The collected total Multiplier and Jackpot value is multiplied by your current bet amount after all wins have been paid out. Only 1 Clover Crystal can land at a time. Clover Crystals cannot land in a Golden Frame.

modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.retrigger:
extra free spins:

modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game maintains the base game's mechanics. In addition, 1 Golden Frame will be on the grid from the start. All Golden Frames are Sticky and remain until the end of the bonus! Golden Frames will be refilled with either a new Multiplier or Jackpot between each spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - GOLDEN HITS
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.retrigger:
extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the BLACK AND GOLD bonus. In addition, 3 Golden Frames will be on the grid from the start and remain until the end of the bonus. All Multiplier values are Sticky and will remain throughout the bonus unless they are part of a win. When a Multiplier participates in a win, its value will double before the next spin. Multiplier values can also double if collected by a Clover Crystal. Each Multiplier doubles only once per spin. The doubled value remains until the Multiplier Frame is doubled again. Multipliers start at a value between 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x.

 When a Jackpot participates in a win, the value will be paid out, and the Frame will be refilled with either a Multiplier or a new Jackpot on the next spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.
